trigger: current active MAIN enters sandbox transition or sandbox mode
recommended_regex: (?:至\s*)?沙盒模式(?:过渡)?|进入沙盒模式|本卷已完成|SANDBOX

handoff_latch.next_generation_must_start_at: Event A of unique enabled target MAIN
handoff_latch.target_event_time_policy: use target MAIN Event A own date/time anchor
handoff_latch.release_condition: latest assistant world-main confirms target MAIN Event A and is non-sandbox
handoff_latch.release_action: disable handoff marker only; keep target MAIN enabled; rearm auto-advance
handoff_latch.sandbox_while_latched: never advance again; keep target MAIN and continue requiring Event A

transaction: same serial worldbook transaction switches MAIN and enables handoff control entry
guards: sandbox evidence must come from current latest message
historical sandbox text must not trigger
one transition per chat/context + message_id + active MAIN
current worldbook must have exactly one enabled timeline entry
native explicit MAIN must match enabled MAIN
handoff marker enabled forbids any further auto-advance
target MAIN must confirm Event A before auto-advance is rearmed
previous volume sandbox cannot be reinterpreted as target volume completion
write success before UI ACTIVE update
side_policy: manual selection only; manifest list order is not chronology
